message:
The other night, we had a surprise blackout during dinner. I fumbled around for candles, but then I remembered my trusty power bank and a couple of flashlights stashed away in the kitchen drawer. I was actually *prepared* this time! 

It felt great to keep my phone charged and our food safe while everyone else was scrambling in the dark. I even lit up the room with my little lantern, turning what could’ve been a frustrating situation into a cozy family game night instead. 

Have you ever found yourself being the prepared one? What’s your go-to trick for handling power outages?
